<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission scrutiny:</strong> The Supreme Court has sought a response from the Election Commission regarding 48 questions posed by the INDIA bloc concerning the System for Integrated Reporting (SIR), electoral rolls, and decision-making processes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Cabinet performance review:</strong> Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired a Council of Ministers meeting to evaluate performance, fueling national speculation regarding a potential Cabinet reshuffle.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPcWQwRXluOTBnNUZ5ZlozUE1vMVlqalZxVHF0cURwNlB0ci1WVFlzdC1WVFZobkVEdjdDZ3VMNmtTaVg1V3JuZHZkTllWejd5TWk3OFdZWlVZX1NUaE1BeHIxWGpfaEF4SzZIeTlGYWR6cGRVY080Q1ZLRDVjNTh2Q2x6U1Z0N1ZOZ0RnOFg4QWV0a05feXF4NGJtV0w0ZHpUdTVjb2FfOU9RQmpDOUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bengaluru civic polls:</strong> The Karnataka government and the State Election Commission have petitioned the Supreme Court to permit the conduct of Bengaluru civic elections using existing electoral rolls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>
